properties.description: Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team is a world-renowned constructor competing at the pinnacle of motorsport in the FIA Formula One World Championship. Based in the United Kingdom, the team is celebrated for its historical dominance and technical sophistication, underpinned by a culture of relentless innovation and determination. It integrates elite engineering talent and high-performance management to develop race-winning vehicles. The brand consistently sets benchmarks in both sporting achievement and sustainable operational practices within the global racing circuit.
properties.short_description: Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team is a Formula 1 racing team and 8-time World Champions known for competing at the highest level of motorsport.

properties.description: Established in 1963, this iconic organization is a powerhouse in international motorsport, primarily recognized for its long-standing participation in Formula One. The team combines rigorous engineering expertise with a commitment to high-performance technology to maintain its competitive edge on the track. Beyond racing, it has expanded its footprint into Formula E and professional sim racing, creating a multi-faceted entertainment brand. With a dedicated global fanbase, it continues to define its legacy through both historical achievements and a forward-looking focus on innovation and sustainability.
